title: Toasters, fans and a red vacuum: the Cincinnati volunteers who have mended nearly 1,400 cast-offs

posts.facebook:
Nearly 1,400 toasters, fans and vacuums saved from landfill, mended by volunteers who need no experience to join.

Cincinnati's Tinker Team has restored nearly 1,400 household electronics in a year and a half, with no budget for parts and no experience needed to join. What they fix, why repair is worth learning, and how to find a repair event near you.

Most broken things are less broken than they look, and the quickest way to learn to fix them is to sit beside someone who already can.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/connect/cincinnati-tinker-team-repairs/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
